subject.title: fix: prevent operational notices from leaking to source chats

question: Should `messages.operationalReplies.redirect` permanently fail closed when its operator-session write fails, or should OpenClaw define a recoverable retry/diagnostic contract that still never falls back to the source chat?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the privacy-versus-observability outcome for failed redirected notices; tests can verify an implementation, but cannot choose the acceptable product/security contract.

options.title: Approve fail-closed redirect
options.body: Keep source delivery suppressed on redirect persistence failure and document the resulting operator-visible diagnostic and recovery path.

options.title: Define safe recovery
options.body: Add a durable retry or operator-facing recovery mechanism that never exposes the notice back to the source chat.

options.title: Defer redirect mode
options.body: Land no redirect behavior until its failure and persistence contract has explicit owner approval.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed redirect
recommendation.body: Keep source delivery suppressed on redirect persistence failure and document the resulting operator-visible diagnostic and recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared session persistence, transcript writes, and core delivery behavior rather than one channel adapter.
